description: Watch a live site's design score (Pro). Standout re-audits the URL about once a day and emails an alert when the design regresses: a drop of more than 5 points, or falling below the 85 client-ready bar. Use it right after shipping a client site so a broken deploy is caught before the client sees it. Up to 10 active watches per license.

email.description: Where regression alerts go. Defaults to the email bound to this license.

url.description: Full public page address to watch, e.g. https://client-site.com

name: watch_site
